input: How do I build credit history in Singapore?
reply: You're 2 of 5 steps in. Next: a student secured card. This is education, not an official credit score.

steps.title: Open a local bank account
steps.why: Local banks report account history to the credit bureau.

steps.title: Phone bill on autopay, on time
steps.why: On-time recurring payments are the easiest positive signal.

steps.title: Student secured card
steps.why: A small secured limit used lightly and repaid in full builds history fast.

steps.title: Keep usage under 30%
steps.why: Low utilisation of your credit limit improves your score.

steps.title: 6 months of clean history
steps.why: After six months most lenders can score you properly.
